title: Spokes
description: Shape of src/data/spokes.yaml: one entry per physical spoke, mapping the names tensometers use for it. That every tensometer name is listed exactly once is checked by scripts/check-spokes.js, not by this schema.

spoke.description: Unique key of the spoke, 'head - middle - thread (name)' in mm. The middle is a diameter (round) or 'width*thickness' (bladed). Head and thread are given together or not at all; the name is optional. A blade of unknown width is '?*thickness', without head and thread. A spoke of unknown dimensions is just '(name)'.

alternative_names.description: Other names tensometer charts use for this spoke. Omitted when the only name is the 'spoke' key itself.

material.description: What the spoke is made of; omitted for steel. Spokes of different materials bend differently even at the same size, so tension estimates never relate spokes of different materials.
